invariant: Each sequence group captures its merged root.element.sequenceDiagram.group style at construction. Its RoundCorner diameter drives both the full frame URectangle and the header tab: SVG frame rx/ry are RoundCorner/2, and a nonzero header begins at left+RoundCorner/2 and closes its top-left edge with an arc of that radius. The style snapshot is owned by the group source epoch, so later declarations do not restyle an earlier group.
causal_divergence: Rust resolves skinparam roundcorner only into participant head and note radii. Both group-frame emission sites always serialize square rects, and the GroupStart header always emits the zero-corner polygon. In the preserved dpi 125 checker input, Java resolves RoundCorner 18 before the group and emits base radius 9 (scaled to rx/ry and arc radii 11.7188); Rust omits both. The frame dimensions, header dimensions, stroke, fill, text, note corner, and scaling already agree.
planned_change: Resolve the sequence group style through StyleCascade at each GroupStart.source_line, falling back to the final compatibility value only for legacy zero-source-line models. Feed the resulting radius into both non-Teoz back-layer frame rects and inline frame rects, and emit ComponentRoseGroupingHeader's rounded top-left path when nonzero. Preserve the existing square byte shape when radius is zero, and retain the generic scaler as the sole document-scale step.
perturbation_axes: roundcorner zero versus nonzero and odd versus even diameters
style or skinparam declaration before versus after group construction
single versus nested groups and alt/else branches
renamed participants, group labels, and changed message counts
scope_boundary: This mechanism owns only sequence group frame and header round-corner style resolution and paint. It does not alter notes, participant heads, frame dimensions, group layout, colors, stroke widths, generic SVG scaling, comparator behavior, or fixture eligibility.
acceptance: The preserved fractional-dpi group-and-note checker input passes diff_one --no-oracle.
Tests prove frame and header share one group-owned radius while zero remains byte-compatible.
Fresh Java perturbations cover source order, nested topology, Teoz, scale form, labels, and corner boundaries.
The renderer suite and no-oracle ratchet remain green without family regression.
An independent checker records an accepted verdict at the exact implementation revision.
forbidden_approaches: matching Review Window, the checker fixture, dpi 125, or known coordinates
post-hoc SVG surgery or adding arcs in the generic scaler
applying the final roundcorner value to every historical group regardless of source order
changing comparator tolerance, baselines, or fixture eligibility
